title: Honest frames with a substituted manifest -> RECEIPT_MANIFEST_MISMATCH

source.model: S-P2 Q5-C2 companion (both set pins removed), degraded

source.kind: query true (the strict tuple pin closes it)

scenario: An honest key ends up accepted under a manifest it never signed: the manifest is swapped for one naming another valid gpg key.

mutations.with: F_manifest with sset = [another valid gpg fingerprint]

test_universe.post_edit: rebuild F_manifest with another fingerprint; keep a_sig

partial_overlap: RC-b (bad manifest_sha256 on the frame side)

needs: A real receipt; build a manifest frame (no signing).

subcases.construction: A-a; post-issue: manifest replaced by F_manifest with sset = [fp of TEST key other-gpg]; a_sig kept
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*): the edit leaves a_sig and receipt_anchor untouched, so rows 11.1-11.4 still pass; U from the same headers
